c45: The man slowly breathes and blinks while staring up at the clock. The digital clock counts up one second at a time: 22:45:45, 22:45:46, 22:45:47, 22:45:48, 22:45:49. Very subtle slow push-in.
brain: The concentric cyan rings pulse outward continuously from the glowing brain, the brain glows brighter and dimmer, gentle slow zoom in.
watch: The man checks his wristwatch, smiles relaxed and slowly lowers his arm, the second hand of the wall clock moves, subtle camera move.
typing: The man types frantically, flames flicker on the keyboard, cyan light streaks swirl.
panic: The man panics, grabs his jacket and turns to rush out, the clock hands spin rapidly, the red alarm light pulses.
waiting: The bored man sighs and slowly shifts in his chair, sand runs through the hourglass, slow push-in.
stopwatch: The stopwatch slowly rotates a little and glows, cyan particles orbit around it, the display stays at 00:00.
neurons: Electric light pulses travel along the neuron connections, neurons flicker and glow, slow camera drift.
student: The exhausted student slowly lifts his head and rubs his eyes, papers rustle, the desk lamp flickers slightly.
flow: The glowing light ribbons swirl around the deeply focused man while he works on the laptop, slow orbiting camera.
melt: The clock melts and drips slowly over the desk edge, clock parts float upward in swirling mist.
lab: The two scientists exchange a surprised look and the woman writes on the clipboard, numbers on the screen keep counting, slight camera move.
route: A short glowing green route draws itself on the mini map inside the glowing head, the head glows softly, slight push-in.
map: A glowing red route line slowly travels along the long winding streets toward the yellow pin, slow camera glide over the night map.
shower: Water pours down, steam drifts, the man slowly tilts his head back enjoying the shower.
dress: The man hastily pulls the hoodie over his head and hops on one foot, clothes on the bed shift.
door: The man bursts through the door out of breath, the people at the table turn to look at him and tap their watches.
think: The man slowly tilts his head thinking with his hand on his chin, the glowing question mark pulses.
plan: The hand places the glowing green block into the calendar, more green buffer blocks light up one after another.
point: The man smiles confidently and points at the viewer, the glowing rings pulse behind him, slight push-in.
